This sequence describes the requested future user story, not current behavior.
Today the questionnaire builds {careerInterest, skills, coursework,
experienceLevel} and navigates to Recommendations using React Router state.
There is no Express API, saved-profile Prisma model, profile migration,
Validate required selections and build matchingProfile
Create matching profile and related selections
Requires a new, team-approved Prisma model and migration.
No such model exists in the approved schema.
Show save error; retain entered values
Review before implementation: decide whether matching answers should persist,
define student identity and ownership/authentication, approve the matching-
profile schema and migration, and finalize endpoint and error contracts.
Do not couple these answers to the separate localStorage Student Profile.
